llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (making outbound AI phone calls) and only declares one required credential, but there are a few small documentation/coordination gaps you should be aware of before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and instructions all describe a phone-calling/IVR SDK and webhook integration. The declared primary env var (PAMELA_API_KEY) matches the described API key usage. References to SDKs, CLI, and webhooks are coherent with a voice-call platform.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains concrete SDK/CLI instructions and webhook handling details; it does not instruct reading unrelated system files or unrelated credentials. It does, however, reference a webhook secret (PAMELA_WEBHOOK_SECRET) and advises verifying signatures — useful for webhook handling but this env var is not listed in requires.env.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill (no install spec or code files). The README recommends standard package installs via npm/pip for optional SDKs/cli, which is expected and not high-risk. No download-from-arbitrary-URL install steps are included in the skill package itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The registry metadata declares a single required credential (PAMELA_API_KEY), which is proportionate. The runtime doc also mentions storing a separate PAMELA_WEBHOOK_SECRET for webhook verification but that variable is not declared as required — this mismatched documentation should be resolved so users know what to provide and protect.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and is user-invocable. It does not indicate modification of other skills or system-wide settings. Autonomous invocation is permitted by default (normal for skills) and not by itself a red flag here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill looks consistent with a phone-calling SDK: it needs your Pamela API key to place calls and will incur per-minute billing. Before installing: (1) verify the service URLs and domain (thisispamela.com / docs.thisispamela.com) and confirm they are the official provider; (2) be aware calls will bill per minute and may expose call audio/transcripts to the provider — check privacy and compliance; (3) set and protect PAMELA_API_KEY and, if you use webhooks, create and protect PAMELA_WEBHOOK_SECRET (the SKILL.md mentions it but the registry metadata doesn't list it); (4) prefer creating scoped API keys with least privilege and use a test account first; (5) confirm webhook verification is implemented on your endpoints (use the SDK's verify methods) so incoming webhook requests are validated. If you need higher assurance, request the skill author to explicitly declare PAMELA_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the skill metadata and provide a link to public package repositories or GitHub for the SDK/CLI source code.
